320f2946cb.q: What challenges did Pam Johnson face growing up as a military child?
320f2946cb.a: Pam Johnson's father was in the U.S. Air Force, and her family moved frequently every three years or so to different locations including New York, California, Illinois, Omaha Nebraska, Europe (Holland and Germany), and eventually San Antonio and Austin Texas. This constant movement made it difficult to develop longevity in sports and extracurricular activities, as she would just get recognized in something and then move elsewhere.

9d920c9a83.q: How did Pam Johnson finance her education at the University of Texas?

She then moved to Austin and got her own place, working three jobs while attending school at the University of Texas.

f98707ad6e.q: What inspired Pam Johnson to pursue the University of Texas instead of UTSA?
f98707ad6e.a: Pam Johnson initially considered starting at UTSA in San Antonio during its first year to ease into higher education, but found it extremely difficult. She told her father she had to get out of there and go straight up to UT instead. At that point, her father retired from the Air Force, partly because they wanted to move him again, allowing her to pursue her goal at the University of Texas.
